preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: The length of each string n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: Each string s has the length specified by the preceding integer n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in [input().strip() for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of lowercase English letters.
The sum of the lengths of all strings does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == -1 or (is_palindrome(s.replace(c, '')) and return_value[i] == s.count(c) - max(all(s[i] == s[-i-1] or s[i] != c for i in range(len(s)//2)), key=lambda x: s.count(c) if x else 0)) for i, (n, s) in enumerate(zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(t)])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 if it's impossible to make the string a palindrome by erasing some occurrences of one letter, or the minimum number of symbols that need to be erased to make the string a palindrome.
